name: Digital Realty Heraklion HER1
notes: Digital Realty announced the launch of its first Crete data center on 2025-04-08. The Heraklion listing identifies HER1 at Epsilon & Theta Street, Building Block 18, Heraklion, with 5,780 sq ft / 537 sq m colocation space. DCD reported 1MW IT load with expansion potential to 5MW; earlier planning references cited up to 6.5MW installed IT load.

name: Sparkle Chania Data Center
notes: Sparkle's Greece Data Centers page says its Greek footprint includes three Athens-area data centers and one in Chania on Crete, with 14,000 sq m total across Greece. Grid Telecom's 2021 collaboration announcement described TI Sparkle Greece as operating three proprietary data centers totaling 8,000 sq m and 6MW, with the third in Chania, Crete; project-level MW for Chania alone was not disclosed.

name: Lancom Balkan Gate Heraklion Crete
notes: Lancom's data-center service page references Balkan Gate Heraklion Crete as completing a Thessaloniki-Athens-Crete axis and serving as a carrier-neutral hub for Mediterranean subsea fiber. Trade coverage in May 2022 reported Lancom/Balkan Gate planned a Tier III-quality facility on Crete; Baxtel lists the Heraklion project as planned for 2026. Capacity was not found in public sources.

name: Grid Telecom / Quadrivium Digital Chania CLS and Data Center Campus
notes: Grid Telecom/IPTO announced with Quadrivium a new cable landing station in Crete; DCD described the Chania project as a 20MW campus. DataCenterMap records the Chania site as an announced 20MW data center following the May 2024 Grid Telecom/Quadrivium announcement.
